influences.name: Jimmy Iovine
influences.context: Simple Minds began consciously writing for large arenas. This ambition is evident in their collaborations with producers like Jimmy Iovine.

influences.name: The Who
influences.context: I grew up with their music, and when I saw them recently [as part of a run billed as their last big tour] I felt emotional because I realised that it really is the end of an era for them – and for bands such as Simple Minds, as well.

influences.name: The Beatles
influences.context: hearing "Eleanor Rigby" coming from the kitchen table radio while getting ready for school

influences.name: The Doors
influences.context: hearing The Doors' "Riders On the Storm" while riding in his father's new car

influences.name: David Bowie
influences.context: hearing a mix of glam (David Bowie, Marc Bolan) and prog-rock (Yes, Genesis) when he was 13 that fueled his love of music

influences.name: Julia Cameron
influences.context: Then about ten years ago I read a book on creative writing by Julia Cameron where she talked about the idea of daily notes and daily pages. She wrote that creativity is a muscle that needs to be flexed.

influences.name: Andy Wright
influences.context: Our producer on the new album, Andy Wright, was the first guy to say to me, 'Your second verse should be your first verse.' He told me that if I made it the first verse it's much more personal.

influences.name: Edward Hopper
influences.context: I'll see a picture, a room, a landscape, or a person that will remind me of an Edward Hopper painting.

influences.name: Mikhail Bulgakov
influences.context: My favorite book is by Bulgakov called The Master and Margarita.
